mechanism: Methylprednisolone can reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of irbesartan through glucocorticoid-induced sodium retention and increased vascular resistance, while irbesartan may increase renal potassium loss during corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and serum potassium levels; irbesartan dose may require adjustment if methylprednisolone therapy is prolonged or at high doses.
